evidence.observation: Reflux flow collapsed to ~0.005 L/h at k=9-13 while distillate jumped to 0.6-0.8 L/h; flows remain erratic (FT704 spikes to 1.08 at k=20)
Reported ratio stays ~3.6-4.9 and is inconsistent with measured FT703/FT704, suggesting stale or computed-elsewhere value
Differential pressure went negative (-1.29, -0.61) then swung to 3.87 mbar, consistent with loss of internal liquid traffic
Upper-column temperatures drifting down ~1.5 °C and rectifying profile degrading since reflux loss
Reboiler reading ~415-420 °C, physically implausible vs 81 °C next stage — likely thermocouple fault

args.missing_evidence: Reflux splitter/valve command vs. FT703 feedback, condenser sub-cooling and receiver level, and an independent reboiler temperature to confirm whether T701 is a sensor fault; a distillate composition sample would show separation status.
